title: Yantian Night Market
description: Xiaomin Xu visited the biggest night market in Shenzhen. Yantian Night Market is a 300-meter street with 170+ stalls serving regional snacks, daily necessities, pieces and accessories. Discover its 16-year history, strict hygiene/fire safety regulations, and community-led management. Witness how this "unapproved" gem thrives through innovation, cultural harmony, and grassroots governance in a bustling metropolis.
